[USER] User is concerned about the effects of too much cardiovascular exercise on muscle fatigue or injury in high-impact sports such as running or basketball.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Yes, too much cardiovascular exercise can lead to muscle fatigue or injury in high-impact sports such as running or basketball.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Excessive cardio can cause overuse injuries such as shin splints, IT band syndrome, and plantar fasciitis.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Excessive cardio can also cause muscle fatigue and decrease the ability to perform at a high level, leading to poor performance and possible injury.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Balancing cardio with strength training and proper rest is important to prevent these issues.  
[USER] User is looking for recommendations on how often to do cardio versus strength training.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The American College of Sports Medicine suggests adults should aim for at least 150 minutes of moderate-intensity aerobic exercise or 75 minutes of vigorous-intensity aerobic exercise each week, plus two or more days of strength training.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The specific amounts of cardio and strength training depend on the user's fitness goals, current fitness level, and any underlying health conditions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] It's best to consult with a qualified fitness professional to create a tailored workout plan.  
[USER] User wants to ensure they are not overdoing it and causing harm to their body.  
[USER] User is seeking tips for preventing workout injuries.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for preventing workout injuries include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Warm-up before exercise: Spend 5-10 minutes warming up with light cardio or stretching.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Wear appropriate footwear and clothing: Use well-fitting shoes and comfortable clothing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Use proper form: Focus on maintaining proper form during exercises.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Gradually increase the intensity of your workout: Increase duration and intensity slowly over time.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Rest and recover: Allow time for rest and recovery between workouts.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Stay hydrated: Drink plenty of water before, during, and after exercise.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Listen to your body: Pay attention to pain or discomfort and stop if necessary.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Cross-train: Mix up workout routines to avoid overuse injuries.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The best way to prevent injuries is to exercise safely and
